notes: Internal review stage: only f0 is detailed; no additional floors are created and nothing has been applied. All 15 reserved elements retain their exact IDs and geometry.
Preserved 54 × 36 m footprint, metres, f0 metadata and 4 m storey height. Added walls use 0.18 m internally and 0.28 m on south/north perimeter rooms; reserved thicknesses remain unchanged.

Auditorium patterns expand to exactly 150 individual audience chairs: three blocks of 10 rows × 5 chairs. Two longitudinal aisles separate the blocks; rear foyer reserves additional wheelchair/companion accommodation without deleting audience chairs. Stage has approximately 51 m² for 12 performers. Raked seating, sightlines, acoustic treatment and accessible stage access require further design.

Reception patterns provide 4 staff chairs and 12 waiting seats; admissions has 8 desks and 8 staff chairs; consultations each have 4 seats. Café has 10 four-seat tables, exactly 40 customer chairs and 4 service-staff positions. Dressing rooms each contain 6 chairs; green room contains 12 chairs; AV and receiving each contain 2 operator chairs.

Gallery capacity of 80 and staff capacities are programme assumptions, not an occupancy calculation. Kitchen uses preparation, cooking and washing work zones for six staff, with separate cold/dry supplies storage.

West spine serves stage, backstage and kitchen/loading. East spine serves admissions. Reception connects to the central courtyard approach; gallery connects to the south courtyard corridor. Doors at cross-links are intended as managed public/service thresholds; access-control operation remains unresolved.

Kitchen-to-café service uses the west spine and north core corridor, requiring timed or controlled crossings. A dedicated food-service lift or segregated delivery passage is not modelled in this ground-only stage.

The shared sanitary reservation is preserved with two accessible WC/basin equipment sets. Separate cubicle partitions, individual doors and turning clearances remain unresolved; do not interpret the shared room as two completed accessible toilets. Additional guest fixtures are provisional.

Window openings at the courtyard edge glaze its circulation ring; the AV viewing window is an explicit internal control-room observation opening. Exterior east glazing lights the perimeter circulation spine.

Room rectangles and furniture grids fit their stated areas without crossing the courtyard. Wall junctions, finished clear widths, structural columns, services, fire strategy, terrace/upper-floor design, construction cost and approvals remain outside this concept.
